Secondary artifacts include an overly smooth, plastic-like texture on the white steel beams (lack of weathering/rust) and slight perspective warping on the upper rim. These issues prevent the image from achieving high photorealism, resulting in a below-average artifact score compared to pristine real-world imagery.
